name: AMZ Vault
description:
AMZ Vault connects your Amazon Seller Central and Amazon Advertising accounts to Claude, so you can ask about your business in plain language and act on the answer.
 
TRUE PROFIT, NOT ESTIMATES
Your P&L is built from Amazon settlement data - every fee, refund and reimbursement exactly as Amazon posted it, not from estimated fee schedules. Add your COGS and you get contribution margin and breakeven ACoS per product, per marketplace, per day.
 
COMPLETE PPC MANAGEMENT
Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display in one place: campaign performance, search terms, placements, match types, keyword and competitor research, dayparting, budgets and automation rules. Because profit and advertising sit in the same warehouse, bids can be judged against real margin rather than ACoS alone.
 
NOTHING APPLIES WITHOUT YOU
101 tools: 71 read-only, 26 that stage changes, 4 that run the approval flow. Write tools do not act - they save a reviewable diff of exactly what would change. Applying it is a separate, explicit confirmation that restates in plain language what you are approving. Exactly one tool in the connector can change your Amazon account. Automation rules that run unattended can only be enabled in the app, never by the AI.
 
THINGS TO ASK
"How profitable was each product last month, after every fee and my real COGS?"
"Which search terms spent over $20 in 30 days with no orders? Stage exact-match negatives."
"What keywords is my top competitor ranking for that I'm not targeting?"
"Build a Sponsored Products launch for this ASIN at $50/day."
"Anything I should worry about this week?"
 
REQUIREMENTS
An AMZ Vault account with at least one connected Amazon seller account. Read-only team members stay read-only through the connector. Docs at amz-vault.com/docs. A complete working demo on synthetic data is at amz-vault.com/demo, no signup required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AMZ Vault to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AMZ Vault to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.amz-vault.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AMZ Vault MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AMZ Vault lists 97 MCP tools, including account_feedback, account_management_guide, account_ops_events, account_profiles, account_report, account_sellers, account_support_access, aplus_document, automation_activity, automation_aoe_status, automation_dayparting, and automation_minmax_results.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AMZ Vault?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AMZ Vault in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does AMZ Vault MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: AMZ Vault requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AMZ Vault is developed by AMZ Vault. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
